method: every VISIBLE sheet, every column, every row of every deliverable the same-head measure record lists — judged by stage2-measure-clipping.py's own metrics, imported rather than reimplemented
why_this_exists: the committed oracle reads 3 sheets through an 8-column / 80-row window (RB2-R2-001 hid there); the first expanded scan then discovered its books by globbing ONE root and never opened the 18 By Day deliverables, which day_matrix publishes under the app's own comparisons root (RB2-R2-EG-003)
discovery: NOT a glob. The deliverable list is taken from the same-head measure record, the runtime digests must match, and a recorded deliverable that cannot be resolved on disk is fatal. Globbing still runs as a cross-check only: anything on disk the record does not list is reported.

head.role: AFTER — must be zero owned clipped cells

base.role: BEFORE — the base output; a large count here is the defect being fixed, not a failure of this pass

by_day_lane_note: the By Day lane is head-only, exactly as acc_measure.extra_roots records it — so 60 deliverables on the head side and 42 on the base side is the correct pair, not a shortfall

git.clean_note: `clean` covers the whole worktree; `runtime_clean` covers only the files the runtime digest is taken over. A result written into the worktree necessarily observes clean=false.

runtime.files_note: per-file digests omitted here by design; the full listing is in RB2-A1-manifest.json and is re-derivable from the tree by rb2-verify-manifest.py
